body.name: Scale-erased excitation model class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{p,E}(d)=\{(B,v,(R_e)_{e\in\mathcal E}):Y_e=BY_e+\varepsilon_e,\ R_e=\operatorname{corr}((I_p-B)^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(v)D_e(I_p-B)^{-\mathsf T})\text{ for }e=0,\ldots,E-1\}\), with membership determined by the three listed member properties.
